note: SESNSP open-data page: scraped at each download for the current 'Municipal-Delitos' link (the file URL changes every month). Not verified from the sandbox where this module was written.

Direct URL of the municipal file for the WHOLE series ('Municipal-Delitos-2015-<year>_<mon><year>.zip', also a SharePoint/OneDrive or Google Drive share link). When set it is used instead of scraping the page. Leave empty to scrape the SESNSP page (it may pick a current-year-only file).

Whole series 2015-2025 ('Municipal-Delitos-2015-2025_<mon><year>.zip', SharePoint link from the SESNSP page, 2026-11-05). Saved as <date>_mx_municipal_delitos_2015_2025.zip and stacked with the current-year file. Downloaded only when this URL is set; the zip can also be copied by hand with that name.
Optional: URL of the state file 'Estatal-Delitos-2015-<year>_<mon><year>.csv'. When a copy exists, the state rows come from it instead of the sum of the municipios.

INEGI, Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020, ITER national file (zip with one CSV: ENTIDAD, MUN, LOC, POBTOT...; municipal totals = rows with LOC 0). Términos de Libre Uso del INEGI (open, attribution). One year (2020) used for every year of the series: rates are approximate away from 2020. The CONAPO projections (official URLs 404; the datamx.io copy has an expired certificate) can be added as population_conapo_* when a working link exists.
Optional: CONAPO municipal projections (any CSV/XLSX with a 5-digit municipal key, a year and a population column). Empty = not downloaded.
Optional: direct URL of an INEGI Marco Geoestadístico zip that contains 00ent.shp and 00mun.shp (CVEGEO, NOMGEO). Empty = geoBoundaries ADM1/ADM2 (CC BY 4.0).
